title: Managing Office 365 - An Overview
description: ​Moving to Office 365 means a different way of doing things for your IT department. Learn about the admin tools included in Office 365 so you can be in control of your environment!  https://www.office.com/it

asr.full_text: Hi, I'm Shilpi Sinha. I'm a principal program manager in Office 365. Moving to Office 365 means a different way of doing things in your IT department. We understand. Office 365 includes powerful tools so you can be in control of your environment. The main tool is the Office 365 admin center. And when you're on the go, you can access key admin functionalities right from the Office 365 Admin Center. And when you're on the go, you can access key admin functionalities right from the Office 365 Admin App. You can get your organization up and running in the cloud, register your domain, setup e-mail, manage the service so everyone in your organization is productive with Office 365. Moving to the cloud shouldn't mean losing visibility into the service incidents. That's why the Admin Center includes the Service Health Dashboard. Out shouldn't mean losing visibility into the service incidents. That's why admin center includes the service health dashboard. You also need to manage change for your organization. The message center keeps you aware of new and updated features and planned maintenance. And if you need more advanced service management, run scripts through PowerShell to automate repetitive tasks and access additional capabilities. And you can use Office 365 APIs to integrate management tools into your existing solutions. As an admin, you get to choose. And how are your users handling this move? Usage reporting helps you see how your users are adopting and using Office 365, and you can design the right type of outreach so that everyone gets the most out of Office 365. Power BI is the next generation of reporting in the Microsoft stock. It uses powerful visualizations, connections to any kind of data source you want to pull in statistics and numbers and be able to easily generate reports without having a PhD in pie charts. In the adoption content pack Power BI is used to deliver an immediately effective series of dashboards organized from high-level of service suite down into individual software's and services. Go to office.com slash IT and find all the resources you need to get started as an Office 365 admin.
